list.name: model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT model FROM (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.request_log WHERE model != '' UNION ALL SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE model != '') ORDER BY model

list.name: api_key
list.label: Client API Key
list.query: SELECT k AS __text, k AS __value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') AS k FROM llm_gateway.request_log) ORDER BY k

panels.title: Prefill Speed by Model (tok/s, content-TTFT)
panels.description: Prompt tokens / content-TTFT, mean and median (p50). Streaming rows with valid timing only; models gated to >=100 responses in range. Timing windows < 100 ms are excluded (single-chunk buffered responses produce degenerate rates).

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100) SELECT * FROM (SELECT concat(model, ' (avg)') AS metric, round(avg(prompt_tokens / nullIf(ttft_content_ms, 0) * 1000), 2) AS value FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' AND is_stream = 1 AND ttft_content_ms >= 100 AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY model UNION ALL SELECT concat(model, ' (p50)') AS metric, round(medianExactIf(prompt_tokens / nullIf(ttft_content_ms, 0) * 1000, ttft_content_ms >= 100), 2) AS value FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' AND is_stream = 1 AND ttft_content_ms >= 100 AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY model) ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 40

panels.title: Decode Speed by Model (tok/s, content-TTFT)
panels.description: Completion tokens / (duration - content-TTFT), mean and median (p50). Streaming rows with valid timing only; models gated to >=100 responses in range. Timing windows < 100 ms are excluded (single-chunk buffered responses produce degenerate rates).

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100) SELECT * FROM (SELECT concat(model, ' (avg)') AS metric, round(avg(completion_tokens / nullIf(duration_ms - ttft_content_ms, 0) * 1000), 2) AS value FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' AND is_stream = 1 AND ttft_content_ms >= 100 AND duration_ms - ttft_content_ms >= 100 AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY model UNION ALL SELECT concat(model, ' (p50)') AS metric, round(medianExactIf(completion_tokens / nullIf(duration_ms - ttft_content_ms, 0) * 1000, is_stream = 1 AND ttft_content_ms >= 100 AND duration_ms - ttft_content_ms >= 100), 2) AS value FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' AND is_stream = 1 AND ttft_content_ms >= 100 AND duration_ms - ttft_content_ms >= 100 AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY model) ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 40

panels.title: Cancel / Provider-Abort Rate (streams)
panels.description: aborted=1 client cancel, aborted=2 provider abort, over is_stream=1 rows in range.

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100) SELECT round(countIf(aborted = 1) * 100.0 / nullIf(countIf(is_stream = 1), 0), 2) AS "Cancels %", round(countIf(aborted = 2) * 100.0 / nullIf(countIf(is_stream = 1), 0), 2) AS "Provider Aborts %" FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND is_stream = 1 AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated)

panels.title: Wasted Tokens & Cost
panels.description: Wasted = tokens generated on aborted streams, absolute and as % of all completion tokens; Cost of Wasted = spend on aborted streams. Effective Cost = total spend / completed (non-aborted) responses.

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100), agg AS (SELECT sum(if(aborted > 0, completion_tokens, 0)) AS wasted_tokens, sum(completion_tokens) AS total_tokens, round(sumIf(cost, aborted > 0), 2) AS wasted_cost, round(sum(cost) / nullIf(countIf(aborted = 0), 0), 2) AS cost_per_completed FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated)) SELECT toString(wasted_tokens) AS "Wasted Tokens", concat(toString(round(100 * wasted_tokens / nullIf(total_tokens, 0), 2)), '%') AS "Wasted % of Total", concat('$', toString(floor(wasted_cost)), '.', leftPad(toString(round((wasted_cost - floor(wasted_cost)) * 100)), 2, '0')) AS "Cost of Wasted Tokens", concat('$', toString(floor(cost_per_completed)), '.', leftPad(toString(round((cost_per_completed - floor(cost_per_completed)) * 100)), 2, '0')) AS "Cost per Completed Response" FROM agg

panels.title: Decode tok/s: historical proxy (ESTIMATE)
panels.description: ESTIMATE: completion_tokens / upstream_response_time_s via the request_id ASOF join; includes prefill time, so it is a lower bound. Use for pre-TTFT-capture history only; panels above are authoritative once ttft_content_ms accumulates.

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100) SELECT toStartOfHour(r.timestamp) AS time, u.model AS label, round(avg(u.completion_tokens / nullIf(r.upstream_response_time_s, 0)), 2) AS value FROM llm_gateway.request_log r ASOF LEFT JOIN llm_gateway.usage_log u ON r.request_id = u.request_id AND r.timestamp >= u.timestamp WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND r.upstream_response_time_s > 0 AND u.completion_tokens > 0 AND coalesce(nullIf(r.key_id,''), nullIf(r.api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) AND u.model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND u.model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY time, u.model ORDER BY time, label
